name: Warda Patisserie
summary: Warda Patisserie is a Detroit patisserie owned by Warda Bouguettaya, who won the 2022 James Beard Award for Outstanding Pastry Chef. The bakery is known for tarts, pastries, and breads influenced by Bouguettaya's Algerian heritage and world travels, with items including frangipane galettes, shakshuka buns, quiche, and croquembouche available for special order. A bistro-style seating area allows dine-in alongside coffee. The official website returned a server error at the time of verification, so operational facts below come from the official URL only and no third-party data was used for hours.
